title: RTL-Debug-150 agent answer
description: The single JSON object the agent must return for one case. No prose outside this object.

root_cause.description: One-paragraph explanation of the bug in the voice of a commit message. Say what is wrong, where, and why the fix works. No apologies. No restating the question.

localization.description: Which file/line ranges the agent believes are the root cause. Multiple entries allowed if the fix genuinely spans several places.

file.description: Repo-root-relative POSIX path, e.g. src/main/scala/foo/Bar.scala or rtl/core/decode.v

symbol.description: Optional: module / signal / function name at that location.

patch.description: A unified diff (as produced by `git diff` / `diff -u`) that applies cleanly at the buggy commit. Empty string "" means the agent is abstaining (see needs_waveform / unresolved_questions).

confidence.description: The agent's own probability that its patch is functionally correct. 0.0 = pure guess, 1.0 = certain. Used for calibration analysis, not for the headline score.

needs_waveform.description: True if the agent believes the root cause cannot be pinned down from source alone and requires a waveform / attached artifact / running simulation. Honest True is scored higher than a confidently wrong fix (see grading.md §Abstention).

unresolved_questions.description: Specific things the agent could not verify from source (missing artifact, ambiguous spec, unclear timing). Free-form strings, one question per entry.
